info.title: Nuvora
info.description: The nuvora binary: config, HTTP API, OpenAPI document, embedded web app.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description:
An absolute folder. Absent: the filesystem roots (`/` on Unix, drive
letters on Windows).

get.summary: Suggests a library type for a folder the admin is about to add.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: An absolute folder.

delete.summary: Removes the library and its items from the catalog. Files on disk are untouched.

patch.summary: Starts a scan when `paths` or `kind` changed.

post.summary:
Scan now. Scans run over every library and coalesce, so this is the same
scan as `POST /api/scan`; the id must exist.

delete.summary: 409 `last_admin` for the last enabled admin; 400 for yourself.

patch.summary: 409 `last_admin` when the change would leave no enabled admin.

post.summary:
Sets the session cookie. Wrong username, wrong password and disabled
account all answer 401 `bad_credentials`. Each failure for a username makes
the next attempt wait (1 s, doubling, at most 10 s) and 20 failures from one
address within 15 minutes lock it for 15 minutes; until then the answer is
429 `rate_limited` with `Retry-After`.
Ends this session and clears the cookie.

get.summary: Never 401: without a valid session `user` is `None`.

post.summary:
Sign-in for apps (the TV apps): the same check as `login`, but the
session token comes back in the body, to send as `Authorization: Bearer`.
No cookie is set.

get.summary:
The file's font attachments, in stream order. Empty for files without any
(every MP4). The ETag is the file's fingerprint.

One font attachment's bytes, immutable like a subtitle track. 404 when
the stream at `index` is not a font.
The fMP4 init segment.

parameters.name: session
parameters.description:
The player's id for this playback: 1 to 64 letters, digits, `-` or `_`.
Defaults to `default`.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description:
Playlist only: where playback starts, in seconds, so the first
segments made are the ones the player asks for first.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description:
Init segment only: the segment a first run starts at (written into
the playlist).

get.summary:
Direct play. Delegates to `tower_http::services::ServeFile` with the
container's MIME type, which implements `Range` (206 + `Content-Range`),
`If-Range`, `Last-Modified` and `HEAD`, and streams from disk without
buffering. First-frame latency is then disk + network + decoder.

The track as text, extracted with ffmpeg on the first request and read
from the server's cache after that. Answers with
`Cache-Control: private, max-age=31536000, immutable`. 404 when the file
has no subtitle stream at `stream_index`; 400 when the track is not
renderable.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Default `vtt`.

schema.description: The text format a track is delivered in.

get.summary:
Per user: cards carry the signed-in user's progress, and the ETag is
`"<catalog_rev>.<watch_rev>"`, so one user's progress never makes another
user's copy stale.

Reads the WebP from the store (tens of KB) and answers with
`Cache-Control: private, max-age=31536000, immutable` (private: it needs a
session, so a shared cache must not hand it to anyone else). Bad ids are 404, and
ids are parsed to 16 bytes before any path is built.

Per user: `watch` is the signed-in user's state. The ETag is
`"<catalog_rev>.<watch_rev>-<device profile hash>"`.

parameters.name: Nuvora-Device
parameters.description: JSON DeviceProfile

get.summary:
A season's episodes in order, with the signed-in user's watch state and a
playback decision per version for the requesting device. 404 unless `id`
is a season. ETag as `GET /api/items/{id}`.

parameters.name: Nuvora-Device
parameters.description: JSON DeviceProfile

put.summary:
Reports where playback is; the server decides what it means. Under 60 s
stores nothing and clears earlier progress. From 60 s to under 90% of the
duration stores the position. From 90% the movie counts as watched once and
the position is cleared; another report at 90% or more within 3 hours of
that does not count again.

Marks the movie or episode watched, like finishing it. On a show or a
season, marks every episode in it watched; episodes already watched keep
their play count.

delete.summary:
Marks the movie or episode unwatched: clears the position, the play
count and the last finish. On a show or a season, every episode in it.

get.summary: Every library, in the order they were added. Any member may list them.

Group headers for the library page: letters for the title sort (`#`,
then A to Z), decades for year, months for added. Same filters and ETag
as the items.

The library page grid. Per user, with the home ETag
(`"<catalog_rev>.<watch_rev>"`). A malformed cursor, or one minted for
another sort or order, is 400.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Default `all`.

parameters.name: hdr
parameters.description: `true`: only movies with an HDR version. Ignored for TV libraries.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description:
`next` from the previous page, or a group's `after` from the index.
Only valid with the same `sort` and `order`; anything else is 400.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Default 60, clamped to 1..=200.

get.summary:
The live connection: JSON text frames, [`LiveEvent`] from the server
(the first is `hello`), [`LiveCommand`] from the client.

post.summary: Invites someone to watch with you, starting a party if you aren't in one.
Accepts an invitation, leaving any party you're in.

get.summary: Everyone else with an account who can sign in, by name.

Keyset paging on the row's sort key. A malformed cursor, or one from
another row (or library), is 400. Per user, with the same ETag as home.
A library row needs `?library=`; an unknown library is an empty row.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: `next` from the previous page; absent = from the start.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Default 40, clamped to 1..=100.

parameters.name: library
parameters.description:
The library of a `library` row (`library_id` on the home row).
Required for that row, ignored for the others.

get.summary: `issues` name server paths, so only admins see them.

post.summary: Idempotent: while a scan runs, repeated calls queue at most one more.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description:
What was typed. Matching is per word, from the start of each word,
ignoring case and accents. At most 200 characters.

post.summary:
Creates the first admin and signs them in (sets the session cookie). 409
`setup_done` once any user exists.

icon.description: A preset icon name; `None` means the default for its kind.

item_count.description: Items with at least one file present.

missing_paths.description:
Entries of `paths` that cannot be read right now (unmounted share,
permissions). Their items stay in the catalog.

paths.description: Absolute folder paths on the server.

last_seen_at.description:
Unix ms of the latest request from any of the user's sessions;
`None` when the user has no session.

AppSession.description:
An app's session: the token to send as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`,
valid for 30 days and renewed while it is used.

setup_required.description: True until the first admin exists. The web app then shows the welcome flow.

oneOf.description: The signed-in user, or `None` without a valid session.

language.description: For voice actors: the dub, e.g. `"Japanese"`.

CreateLibraryRequest.description:
`paths` are absolute folders that exist on the server; at least one, and
none already used by another library.

icon.description: A preset icon name (see the web app's icon picker).

Details.description:
What AniList (anime), TVmaze (TV) or TMDB (movies) know about a title.
Every field is empty until the server has matched it online.

cast.description:
Billing order. Anime lists each character twice when both dubs are
known: once with the Japanese voice actor, once with the English one.

external_url.description: The title's page at the provider.

DeviceProfile.description:
What a device decodes natively. Sent as compact JSON in the `Nuvora-Device`
header. Codec and container names are the server's canonical names
(`h264`, `hevc`, `av1`, `vp9`; `aac`, `eac3`, `opus`; `mp4`, `mkv`, `webm`).
Unknown names are ignored, never errors, so old servers accept new clients.

Episode.description: One row of a season's episode list.

oneOf.description: 16:9 frame at 10% of the episode, SDR only.

title.description: From the file name, else `"Episode 5"` (`"Special 2"` in Specials).

versions.description:
Best first, each with its playback decision for the requesting device,
as on `MovieDetail`. Empty when every file of the episode is missing.

EpisodeDetail.description:
`GET /api/items/{id}` of an episode id: what the player and an episode
page need, with the show around it.

oneOf.description: The show's.

The episode after this one in order, for "Next episode" in the player.
`None` after the last one.
The show's.

EpisodeRef.description: A pointer to one episode, for "Play S1 E5" buttons and "next episode".

position_ms.description: Where the signed-in user stopped; `None` unless in progress.

oneOf.description: 16:9 frame at 10% of the episode, SDR only.

title.description: From the file name, else `"Episode 5"` (`"Special 2"` in Specials).

ErrorBody.description:
Every API error answers with this body. `code` is stable; `message` is
written for people and may change.

field.description: The request field the error is about, for inline form validation.

ErrorCode.description: Clients must treat an unknown code like `bad_request`.

FontAttachment.description:
A font attached to the file (Matroska attachments). Styled tracks name
fonts that only these provide.

path.description: Absolute; pass it back as `?path=` to open the folder.

FsInspect.description:
A quick look at a folder before adding it as a library: video files under
it, and how many of them are named like episodes. Counts at most 2,000
video files.

suggested_kind.description: `shows` when more than half of the video files look like episodes.

FsListing.description: One folder's subfolders. Files and hidden folders are never listed.

parent.description: The folder above `path`; `None` at a root.

path.description: The listed folder, canonical. Empty for the list of Windows drives.

rows.description: In display order, hidden ones included.
Render in order. Clients render unknown row kinds like any other row.

icon.description: The library's preset icon, on `library` rows that have one.

items.description: The first page, at most 40 cards.

library_id.description: Set on `library` rows: the library page to open from "See all".

next.description:
Opaque cursor for `GET /api/rows/{row}?after=` (plus `&library=` for a
library row). `None` when `items` is the whole row.

oneOf.description:
On `library` rows: the library page query. Later pages come from
`GET /api/libraries/{library_id}/items` with this query and `after=next`.

total.description: Cards in the whole row, not just `items`.

id.description: Chosen by the client, unique in the layout: 1 to 40 letters, digits, `-` or `_`.

title.description: The user's own title; `None` uses the default (the library's name).

Image.description: An artwork. URL: `/api/images/{id}/{size}`. Immutable: cache forever.

aspect_ratio.description: width / height, for layout before the image loads.

placeholder.description: ThumbHash, base64. Decode client-side into a blurred placeholder.

ImageSize.description: Sizes a client can request. Pixel widths are a server decision.

after.description:
Pass as `?after=` (with the same sort, order and filters) to load the
page that starts with this group. `None` for the first group.

key.description:
Stable: `"#"` and `"A"` to `"Z"` for the title sort, `"1990"` (the
decade) or `"unknown"` for year, `"2026-10"` or `"unknown"` for added.

LibraryIndex.description:
The library grid's group headers, in grid order. Only groups with items.
Sorts without groups (`watched`, `runtime`) answer with no groups.

LibraryKind.description:
Chosen when the library is added. Changing it later rebuilds the
library's items.

LibraryPage.description: One page of the library grid: movies, or shows for a TV library.

next.description: Cursor for `?after=`; `None` on the last page.

total.description: Cards matching the filters, across every page.

LibrarySummary.description: A library as every member sees it, for the nav rail and the library page header.

icon.description: A preset icon name; `None` means the default for its kind.

item_count.description: Movies, or shows for a TV library, with at least one file present.

oneOf.description: Play this for the whole party, from `position_ms`.

LiveCommand.description: What a client sends on `/api/live`, as JSON text frames.

oneOf.description: First frame of every connection.
The answer to a `ping`, for measuring clock offset.
The party you are in changed (members, invitations or playback).
You are no longer in `party_id`.
Your pending invitations changed; the whole list.

LiveEvent.description: What the server sends on `/api/live`, as JSON text frames.

tmdb_key_set.description: Anime (AniList) and TV (TVmaze) need no key. Movies need a TMDB key.

versions.description: Best first. Empty when every file of the movie is currently missing.

members.description: Everyone already in the party, inviter included.

online.description: Has the app open right now.

PartyPlayback.description:
The party's shared clock: at server time `at_ms` the position is
`position_ms`; while `playing` it advances in real time from there.
`at_ms` can be a moment ahead, when everyone starts together.

oneOf.description: Who made the change; `None` when the server did.

seq.description: Goes up with every change, so a client applies each one once.

title.description: The movie's or the show's title.

PartyStatus.description: What a signed-in user sees: their party, if any, and invitations to others.

oneOf.description: `None` until someone starts something.

Plays through the server as HLS (fMP4): remuxed, with audio and/or
video converted where this device can't decode them. Append
`?session=<id>` (one id per playback, 1 to 64 of `[A-Za-z0-9_-]`) and
optionally `&start=<seconds>`.

converts_video.description:
The picture is re-encoded (slower to start, uses the server's CPU);
false when only the container or audio changes.

reasons.description: Why it can't play directly, as for `needs_transcode`.

oneOf.description: Nothing the server can do makes it play on this device.

reasons.description: Human-readable: `"HEVC video isn't supported on this device"`.

oneOf.description: The file could not be read (ffprobe failed); nothing will play it.

Playback.description:
What pressing Play does on the requesting device. Clients must treat an
unknown `kind` like `needs_transcode`.

PosterCard.description:
A movie, a show, or (in Continue Watching) an episode. An episode card
carries its show's title, year and poster, `subtitle` names the episode,
`id` is the episode to play and `show_id` the show to open.

progress.description:
How far the signed-in user is into the movie or episode, 0 to 1.
`None` unless it is in progress; a Next Up episode has none.

show_id.description: On episode cards: the show the episode belongs to.

subtitle.description:
A second line under the title: `"S1 · E4"` on an episode in progress,
`"Next episode · S1 · E5"` on a Next Up entry, `"3 new episodes"` on a
show in Recently Added.

unwatched_count.description: On show cards: episodes the signed-in user has not watched.

watched.description:
The signed-in user has finished the movie or episode at least once,
or every episode of the show.

ProgressRequest.description:
Where playback is. Clients send it every 10 s while playing, on pause,
after a seek settles and when leaving the player.

duration_ms.description: At least 1. `position_ms` may exceed it by at most 5 s.

file_id.description: The version playing. Must be a version of this item.

Resolution.description: A movie matches when any of its versions does. Ignored for TV libraries.

RowPage.description: A later page of one row.

issues.description: Files the scan could not read. Empty unless the signed-in user is an admin.

oneOf.description: The show's poster.

people.description: Actors and voice actors, each with what they are in.

titles.description: Movies and shows, best match first.

character.description: Who they play or voice there.

SeasonDetail.description:
`GET /api/items/{id}` of a season id. Its episodes come from
`GET /api/items/{id}/episodes`.

oneOf.description: The show's.

SetupRequest.description:
Creates the first admin. Usernames are 1 to 32 letters, digits, `.`, `_` or
`-`, unique ignoring case. Passwords are at least 8 characters.

ShowDetail.description: A show's page. `next` is what Play starts.

episode_count.description: Episodes with a file present, specials included.

oneOf.description:
The first unwatched episode after the last watched one, in order.
S1 E1 when nothing is watched; `None` when every episode is watched.
Specials never come next.

seasons.description: Numbered seasons in order, then Specials (season 0) last.

watched_count.description: The signed-in user's watched episodes, out of `episode_count`.

year_range.description:
`"2024"`, or `"2019–2024"` once episodes carry years. `None` when no
year is known.

SortOrder.description: Default `asc` for `title`, `desc` for every other sort.

SubtitleFormat.description:
What the track is, for choosing how to draw it. Clients treat an unknown
format like `other`.

SubtitleMode.description:
When the player turns subtitles on. The track chooser in `@nuvora/core`
applies it.

SubtitleTrack.description:
One subtitle track of a version: a stream in the file, or a subtitle
file next to it. Fetch a renderable one from
`/api/files/{file_id}/subtitles/{index}`.

external.description:
A subtitle file next to the video rather than a track inside it.
Its `index` is 1000 or more.

index.description:
The stream index in the file, or 1000 and up for files next to it:
`{stream_index}` in the subtitle URL.

is_hearing_impaired.description: Subtitles for the deaf and hard of hearing (SDH).

renderable.description:
The server can deliver the track as text. False for `image` and
`other`, which need conversion.

version.description: As the tool reports it, e.g. `"7.1.1"`.

UpdateLibraryRequest.description:
Every field is optional. `paths` replaces the whole list; removing a folder
removes its items from the catalog (never from disk). A different `kind`
rebuilds every item of the library and resets watch progress in it (ask
first); a scan then fills in artwork.

icon.description: A preset icon name; `""` goes back to the default for the kind.

UpdateMeRequest.description:
Every field is optional. Changing the password needs both passwords, and
signs out the user's other sessions.

subtitle_language.description:
Three letters, ISO 639-2 (`"spa"`). `null` clears it, back to the
device's language; leaving it out keeps it.

tmdb_api_key.description: A TMDB API key or API Read Access Token. Empty or `null` clears it.

UpdateUserRequest.description:
Every field is optional. Disabling a user or resetting their password signs
them out everywhere. The last enabled admin cannot be demoted or disabled,
and nobody can disable themselves.

subtitle_language.description:
The language subtitles should be in, ISO 639-2 (`"spa"`). `None`
means the device's language.

oneOf.description: `None` when the file could not be read.

summary.description:
One line for the version picker and detail header, built server-side so
every client says the same thing: `"4K · HEVC Main 10 · Dolby Vision · TrueHD 7.1"`.

WatchFilter.description:
Watch filter, for the signed-in user. A show is `watched` when every
episode is, `in_progress` when some are watched or started but not all,
`unwatched` when none is.

WatchState.description: The signed-in user's state for one movie or episode.

last_watched_at.description: Unix ms of the last finish.

position_ms.description: Where to resume. `None` unless the movie is in progress.
